name: Brent L Anderson
occupation: Goshen County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (Goshen County official 2026 general results)
background: Brent L. Anderson is a Goshen County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Michael McNamee, who is serving through the current term. The Torrington Telegram reported that he was one of four Republicans seeking two commission seats in the August 18, 2026, primary. He won a seat in the November 2026 general election. No separate public-record account of his private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
